recipe.variant: Qwen-Image fp8_e4m3fn + lightx2v Lightning 4-step LoRA DISTILLED ON THE FP8 BASE (Qwen-Image-fp8-e4m3fn-Lightning-4steps-V1.0-fp32), 4 steps, cfg 1 - the fast route without grid artifacts
recipe.from_template: image_qwen_image, 'Enable Lightning LoRA' = true branch. The template's own LoRA (Qwen-Image-Lightning-8steps-V1.0, trained on bf16) produces 'a grid-like pattern' on the plain fp8 base (lightx2v README, ModelTC/Qwen-Image-Lightning#32); lightx2v's fix is this fp8-distilled 4-step LoRA, so the file is swapped. No fp8-distilled 8-step LoRA exists

shift.note: 3-3.1 in every template; 'Increase the shift if you get too many blurry/dark/bad images. Decrease if you want to try increasing detail.'

recipe.defaults_note: 4 steps, cfg 1, shift 3 (lightx2v: 'We use shift=3 in distillation'; template keeps 3.1), euler/simple. lightx2v: 'In scenarios involving dense or small text, the base model is more likely to produce better results'; hair-like detail may blur or over-sharpen. Template timing with the 8-step LoRA: ~55 s first / ~34 s second generation.
